summary: Iteration 4 of Elite Concierge — 4 structural changes verified end-to-end. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass (no regression on /api/health, /api/contact validation+honeypot+rate-limit, /api/contacts list, /api/create-web-call Retell real-token call). Frontend landing: sample-call-card fully removed (no [data-testid=sample-call-card], no .sample-card, zero references to sampleAudio/sampleBtn/sampleCaption in JS, body text has zero 'LinkedIn'). Retell #start-voice-demo button present and clickable — handler executes (demo-status updates to 'Could not start demo: Requested device not found' in headless, confirming the click handler ran past the Retell setup). #calc-industry has exactly 13 options in the exact spec order (Select your industry + 12 industries ending with Car Dealership). All 5 NEW presets fill sliders to exact spec values: restaurant→missed=98/value=120/close=40, beauty→49/180/50, gym→32/600/35, property→49/1800/30, car-dealership→67/3200/22. Slider step on #calc-value was reduced from 50→10 so 120/180/280 now land exactly — iteration-3 ecommerce snap bug is also fixed as a side effect. Footer: tagline is exactly 'Always on. Never on hold. Never on payroll.', footer-privacy href='/privacy.html', footer-terms href='/terms.html', footer-email mailto:eliteconcierge@outlook.com, NO LinkedIn anchor. /privacy.html: HTTP 200, title 'Privacy Policy — Elite Concierge', h1 'Privacy Policy', .legal-label 'Legal', subtext starts 'Last updated: May 2025', exactly 11 <section> inside .legal-col (matches spec), .legal-col computed max-width=720px, section h2 22px/700, p 18px/lh28px, 4 mailto:eliteconcierge@outlook.com anchors (spec asked for ≥3: sections 1, 7, 11 — 4 is fine since 'aim to respond' clause adds an extra link), section-1 mailto rendered in rgb(236,28,140) accent pink, cnpd.pt link target=_blank to https://www.cnpd.pt. /terms.html: HTTP 200, title 'Terms of Service — Elite Concierge', h1 'Terms of Service', exactly 12 sections, 2 mailto links (section 12 confirmed). Both legal pages share the same navbar (nav-cta-sales + nav-cta-demo are Calendly anchors with target=_blank) and identical footer (same tagline, no LinkedIn). Mobile 420x820: .legal-col padding=24px/24px on both pages; .nav-burger present and clicking it toggles #nav-drawer.open on both pages. Legal pages contain NO contact modal, NO calculator, NO demo-card, NO marquee — confirmed clean. Zero console errors on landing reload and on both legal pages.
critical_code_review_comments: Side benefit: changing #calc-value step from 50 to 10 in iteration 4 silently resolves the iteration-3 ecommerce preset snap bug (280→280 now exact). Worth noting as a regression-prevention insight for future preset additions.

index.html now ~1262 lines, privacy.html ~315, terms.html ~306. Landing remains a single-file monolith but each legal page is fully self-contained (duplicated navbar/footer/CSS). If a 4th static page is added consider extracting the shared navbar/footer/CSS into a partial or moving to a templated build — duplicating ~150 lines of CSS+markup across 3 files will become a maintenance hazard.

Privacy page has 4 mailto links (spec said sections 1, 7, 11 — we found section 1 once, section 7 twice (the cnpd paragraph + the 'exercise rights' paragraph), section 11 once). Functionally correct and accent-styled; not a defect, just slightly more than the minimum spec.
Both legal pages correctly omit animation/sticky/sidebar logic — only a small JS block for the hamburger drawer remains, which is appropriate.
seed_data_creation: ~12 TEST_-prefixed contact docs created in MongoDB during pytest run (each with unique synthetic X-Forwarded-For IP). No hp- prefixed docs persisted (honeypot path correctly rejects writes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-4 spec items verified green. Backend rate limiter is in-memory — keep using unique X-Forwarded-For per test (see fresh_ip_headers fixture in test_elite_concierge.py). #calc-value step is now 10 (not 50), so future preset avgValue can be any multiple of 10 down to 50. Hamburger button on legal pages uses class '.nav-burger' (NOT data-testid) — selector to use: '.nav-burger' or '#nav-burger'; drawer is '#nav-drawer' and toggles class 'open'. Retell #start-voice-demo click in headless will always fail with 'Requested device not found' — confirm the handler ran by reading #demo-status text; for true API-path verification use curl against POST /api/create-web-call (covered in test_elite_concierge.py::TestCreateWebCall).
rca of the issue: No bugs found in iteration 4. All 4 structural changes (sample card removal, 5 new industry presets, footer tagline + LinkedIn removal, /privacy.html + /terms.html static pages) implemented to spec.
